title: Test Environment Service Contract
authorityBoundary: This contract derives the test environment service inventory from spec/instances/compose-service/service-catalogue.json and does not override the service catalogue.
purpose: Define the composed backing service contract for the USF test-readiness track so service-backed test claims cannot be satisfied by in-memory substitutes.
definitionOfTestEnvironment: The supported test environment uses compose/compose.test.generated.yaml, synthetic data, loopback-only local exposure, resettable Compose resources, and fail-closed validation. Dev in-memory proof remains dev evidence only.

hardEnvironmentRule.description: A required service-backed test-readiness claim must use the composed test target and must not be satisfied by an in-memory, process-local, hermetic, or mock substitute unless the row is explicitly classified as pure local computation or external/live provider out of test-readiness scope.

composeEnvironment.defaultStartupExpectation: required composed services start from the canonical test Compose target with bounded readiness checks in proof or harness code before claims are accepted
composeEnvironment.defaultTeardownExpectation: test proofs and future harness commands must tear down containers, anonymous resources, volumes, temp files, and credentials in finally or equivalent cleanup paths

capabilityDependencyClasses.description: Validation or unit logic that does not represent a required external service and can run without a composed backing service.
A supported test capability that represents a service-backed boundary and must use a composed service for any test-readiness claim.

capabilityDependencyClasses.dependencyClass: external/live provider not in test-readiness scope
capabilityDependencyClasses.description: A live or external provider boundary that is not part of local test-readiness and must remain a non-claim unless later authority adds a safe composed substitute or live-provider proof.
A dev-readiness or lineage proof that may remain valid for its own scope but cannot satisfy service-backed test-readiness claims.
A catalogue row or capability that is explicitly not supported for the current test-readiness claim and must carry a rationale and follow-up or non-claim boundary.

capabilityInventory.nonClaimBoundary: Does not prove any service-backed runtime capability.
Must not satisfy a service-backed test-readiness claim.
